description: PR2/admin. Three-view editorial surface (Queue/Drafts/Published) via searchParams.tab (default queue). Server components for reads (force-dynamic, server-side lib helpers, no client read fetches — matches existing admin pages); small CLIENT components for actions. Files: (admin)/layout.tsx — add <NavItem href=/admin/blog>Blog</NavItem> after Users (layout.tsx:69; layout has force-dynamic at :22, requireAdmin at :25). admin/blog/page.tsx (server) — fetch admin-blog helper, render via DataTable/StatTile (src/components/admin/ both exist); Drafts render body via shared MD_COMPONENTS (T5) with chunks_used beside it; surface needs_attention + error_note. seed-form.tsx (client) — SOLE seeding entry: concept-pair pickers, <ModelPicker>+<ScopeSelector> (T6, fed server catalog), angle; POST /api/admin/blog/seed then refresh. actions.tsx (client) — per-row Generate/Publish/Reject/Archive POSTing to T4 routes + refresh; Generate shows in-flight (BRD §6). DONE: seed form posts valid pair -> Queue; Generate end-to-end -> Drafts (or needs_attention); Drafts show prose+sources; Publish->Published; Reject/Archive work; /admin/blog 404s w/o header. Tests: none automated for pages (logic tested T3/T4); covered by T9. DEPS: T4,T5,T6. BLOCKS: T9. See IMPL T7.

resolution.note: Three-view /admin/blog (Queue/Drafts/Published via ?tab=): server component reads via admin-blog helpers; client islands for seed-form (sole seeding entry, inline scope/model per T6 decision B) and per-row actions. Nav entry added. Drafts render body via shared MD_COMPONENTS + chunks_used sidebar; needs_attention shows error_note. tsc clean; full suite 434 green; production build compiles all blog routes (ƒ dynamic). No page-level tests (matches existing admin pages; logic tested in T3/T4, covered by T9).
